stories.title: Französischer Impressionist – Medien: Polizei nimmt Verdächtige nach Renoir-Diebstahl fest

en.title: French Impressionist – Media: Police arrest suspects after Renoir theft
en.summary: Thieves broke into a museum in Cagnes-sur-Mer, France on September 8 and stole several paintings. Police have arrested suspects in connection with the theft.

stories.title: Krieg in der Ukraine – Gouverneur: Mehrere Tote bei russischem Angriff auf Bus

en.title: War in Ukraine – Governor: Several dead in Russian attack on bus
en.summary: A Russian attack occurred in Kramatorsk in eastern Ukraine, resulting in multiple casualties according to local authorities.

stories.title: MELDUNGEN SCHWEIZ - Cyberangriff auf Softwarelieferant der Pensionskasse des Bundes – sensitive Daten könnten publik werden

en.title: SWISS REPORTS - Cyberattack on software supplier of federal pension fund – sensitive data could be made public
en.summary: A software supplier to Switzerland's federal pension fund has been targeted in a cyberattack that may result in the disclosure of sensitive information.

stories.title: Polizei vor Ort – Jäger filmt mutmasslichen Puma bei München

en.title: Police on scene – Hunter films alleged puma near Munich
en.summary: A hunter recorded video footage of an animal near Munich that an expert believes may be a puma.

stories.title: Remplacer le diesel par de l'huile végétale, la fausse bonne idée qui peut coûter cher

en.title: Replacing diesel with vegetable oil, the false good idea that can be costly
en.summary: Vegetable oils like rapeseed or used cooking oil are sometimes used as fuel in France where they cost less than diesel, but this solution promoted on social media carries significant engine risks.

stories.title: En difficulté, Porsche mise sur moins de modèles, mais plus chers et plus exclusifs

en.title: In difficulty, Porsche bets on fewer models, but pricier and more exclusive ones
en.summary: German sports car maker Porsche is responding to an unprecedented crisis by shifting toward value over volume, reducing sales while raising prices on its most exclusive vehicles.

stories.title: Pensionskasse des Bundes – Name, AHV-Nummer, Lohn – Angreifer erbeuten sensible Daten

en.title: Federal pension fund – Name, social security number, salary – Attackers steal sensitive data
en.summary: A cyberattack on an IT company resulted in the theft of personal data from federal employees, prompting Publica to warn of identity theft risks.

stories.title: LIVE-TICKER - Krieg in der Ukraine: 12 Tote bei russischem Angriff auf Kramatorsk +++ Kiew wird mit Drohnen attackiert

en.title: LIVE TICKER - War in Ukraine: 12 dead in Russian attack on Kramatorsk +++ Kyiv targeted by drones
en.summary: Russia continues its over four-year war against Ukraine with ongoing military operations including attacks on cities and civilian areas.

stories.title: Cyberangriff auf Softwarelieferant der Pensionskasse des Bundes – Daten sind abgeflossen.

en.title: Cyber attack on software supplier of federal pension fund – data breached
en.summary: A cyber attack targeted a software provider serving Switzerland's federal pension fund, resulting in data loss. Federal prosecutors have launched an investigation into the incident.

stories.title: DIE NEUESTEN ENTWICKLUNGEN - Neustrukturierung der Fifa: Der Schweizer Ramon Vega will Fifa-Präsident werden

en.title: Latest developments - FIFA restructuring: Swiss Ramon Vega wants to become FIFA president
en.summary: Swiss Ramon Vega is considering running for FIFA president amid ongoing organizational changes. FIFA abandoned plans in early August to hand over commercial rights to private investors.

stories.title: Herausforderer für Infantino? – Ramon Vega will Fifa-Präsident werden

en.title: Challenger for Infantino? – Ramon Vega wants to become FIFA president
en.summary: Former Swiss national player Ramon Vega has announced his intention to challenge current FIFA president Gianni Infantino in the upcoming presidential election.

stories.title: L’ancien international suisse Ramon Vega veut détrôner Gianni Infantino

en.title: Former Swiss international Ramon Vega wants to unseat Gianni Infantino
en.summary: Former Swiss defender Ramon Vega announced his candidacy for FIFA presidency against incumbent Gianni Infantino, following FIFA's abandoned plan to involve private investors. Vega, 55, previously attempted to run in 2022.

stories.title: Donald Trump nutzte Steuergelder für Eigenwerbung. Jetzt krebst er zurück, aber die Kontroverse läuft weiter

en.title: Donald Trump used taxpayer money for self-promotion. Now he is backing down, but the controversy continues
en.summary: Advertising films were intended to show Americans the country's successes under Trump. However, the controversy over the president initially charging campaign costs to taxpayers threatens to overshadow this message.

stories.title: Überall leere Kassen: China hat die Jagd auf die Reichen des Landes freigegeben

en.title: Empty coffers everywhere: China has unleashed the hunt for the country's wealthy
en.summary: As state revenues decline, China's government is targeting wealthy citizens through legal and questionable methods, causing unrest among millionaires.

stories.title: Nach drei Jahren Krieg haben die Menschen in Gaza ihre Hoffnung verloren – sie trauen weder Israel noch der Hamas

en.title: After three years of war, people in Gaza have lost their hope – they trust neither Israel nor Hamas
en.summary: The heavily destroyed Gaza Strip remains a war zone with little prospect for improvement, leading Palestinians to increasingly distance themselves from Hamas.

stories.title: INTERVIEW - «Dank unserer Abschreckung befinden wir uns nach wie vor im Frieden», sagt der Nato-General

en.title: INTERVIEW - "Through our deterrence, we remain at peace," says NATO General
en.summary: A former NATO deputy commander expresses confidence that Europe can continue relying on the United States, while arguing that European society must make sacrifices to prevent war.

stories.title: «Trump verachtet uns», sagt der Kanadier, der am «Lake America» lebt. «Er hält uns für Abtrünnige und Schmarotzer»

en.title: "Trump despises us," says the Canadian who lives at "Lake America." "He considers us renegades and freeloaders"
en.summary: Canadian workers across various industries view the trade war as personal, with businesses from maple syrup production to hockey equipment manufacturing affected.
